第三章见公安先跪下

闫解放怒目圆睁还夹杂着后怕，连声音都压低了些。

“老四，你确定他经常失踪？”

“确定，我找厂里的人问过了，平均每月都要请假两三次，你也知道哪个工人会轻易请假，那可是实打实的工资啊。”

“不错，顾城绝对没干好事，必须和他划清界限。”

闫解放毕竟是大队长，经常去县城开会，多少还是听闻一些那种暗中的事。

“爸，不管顾城私下在做什么都不能牵扯到闫家，万一呢。”

“是啊，闫家根正苗红本分一辈子，家里三代几十口子可不能被连累。”

“就是就是，爸，赶紧拿个章程吧。”

闫和平赶紧附和，他恨不能立刻替闺女去离婚。

“别急，就算离婚也不能便宜顾家，嫣嫣受的罪更不能白受。”

“对对对，要把顾老婆送去公安那里，杀人偿命天经地义。还有顾城，既然眼瞎还上什么班，回家当一辈子瞎子吧。”

闫和平嚷嚷着把本来打算好的计划给说了出来，再瞥几眼老爷子和大哥的表情。

“看什么看，你那点子心思当谁听不出来？”

闫解放都想扇死老四，一辈子就生一个娃儿，还照顾不好，简直白吃那么多饭，浪费粮食。

“我怕你知道？明明我说的没错。”

魏淑萍看孩子爸梗着脖子不服气，还真有原主的混不吝的劲儿，适时递出个赞赏的眼神。

“行了，老四说的不错，杀人偿命，眼瞎就别上班。

既然如此，老四带人去报公安，嫣嫣不能动那就带着沾血的被单去。

老四媳妇，你带着家里能吵架的去顾城单位，一定要闹到厂领导出面。

老大是大队长，你就跟着家里能打的去顾家，把他家给我掀了，把嫁妆和赔偿全给我带回来。

老大不参与打架，只需要坐在红旗大队大队部拦着人就行，我倒要看看顾家哪来的底气张狂。”

闫嫣眼睛都亮了，老爷子真不错，掀房子，闹厂子，报公安，齐活儿了。

“至于离婚，等嫣嫣能下地了就去，如果顾城不同意，那就去厂里闹到他主动来离。”

Chapter 3: Kneel down before seeing the police

Yan Jiefang's eyes widened with anger and fear, and he even lowered his voice.

"Fourth, are you sure he disappears often?"

"I'm sure. I asked people in the factory. On average, they ask for leave two or three times a month. You also know which worker will easily ask for leave. That's a real salary."

"Yes, Gu Cheng has definitely done nothing good. We must draw a clear line with him."

After all, Yan Jiefang is the captain of the brigade. He often goes to the county town for meetings, and he still hears some secret things.

"Dad, no matter what Gu Cheng is doing in private, it cannot involve the Yan family, just in case."

"Yes, the Yan family has its roots in the family and Miaohong has been responsible for his whole life. The three generations and dozens of people in the family cannot be implicated."

"That's right, dad, hurry up and get the charter."

Yan Heping quickly agreed, wishing he could divorce his daughter immediately.

"Don't worry, even if you get divorced, it won't make it easier for the Gu family, and Yanyan's suffering won't be in vain."

"That's right, that's right. We need to send Mrs. Gu to the police. Murder must be punished with life. And Gu Cheng, why should you work since you're blind? Just go home and be blind for the rest of your life."

Yan Heping yelled and told the original plan, and then glanced at the expressions of the old man and his eldest brother.

"What are you looking at? Who can't tell what you are thinking?"

Yan Jiefang wanted to slap his fourth child to death. He would have only one baby in his life and couldn't take care of it well. He would eat so much food in vain and waste food.

"I'm afraid you know? I'm obviously right."

Wei Shuping saw the child's father scratching his neck and being unconvinced. He really showed the original owner's unsparing spirit, so she gave him an appreciative look at the right time.

"Okay, what the fourth child said is right, kill with a life, and if you are blind, don't go to work.

In this case, Laosi took someone to report to the police. If Yanyan couldn't move, she would take the bloody sheets with her.

Fourth daughter-in-law, if you go to your work unit in Gucheng with someone who can quarrel with you at home, you must make sure that the factory leaders come forward.

The boss is the captain, so you go to the Gu family with the ones who can fight at home, destroy his house for me, and bring me back all the dowry and compensation.

The boss doesn't participate in the fight, he just sits in the Red Flag Brigade headquarters and stops people. I want to see where the Gu family has the confidence to be so arrogant."

Yan Yan's eyes lit up. The old man was really good. He could demolish houses, cause trouble in factories, and report to the police.

"As for the divorce, wait until Yanyan can go to work. If Gu Cheng doesn't agree, then go to the factory to make trouble until he takes the initiative to divorce."
